patterns: when will I get my money back
responses: Refund timing depends on the payment method and bank. Check the refund status in your order details. If it is overdue, contact support with your order ID and refund reference.

patterns: how do I cancel an order
responses: Open Orders, select the order, and choose Cancel if the option is available. Shipped orders may require a return instead.

patterns: money deducted but order not placed
responses: Please check your bank or payment app for the transaction status. If money was deducted but no order was created, save the transaction reference and contact support. Never share your PIN, password, or OTP.
